messages:
anya: Quick proposal — switch scale-out trigger from queued_count >= 5 to p95_queue_ms > 1200 per model, with dynamic headroom based on model QPS. This lets small tails avoid spikes. Thoughts?

kevin: sounds reasonable. how do you compute "dynamic headroom"?

anya: headroom = max(ceil(QPS * headroom_ratio), min_nodes)
example: headroom_ratio=0.15 means 0.15 tokens/sec -> nodes to cover burst. also cap by max_surge.

alex_r: we need to factor interruption probability. If spot eviction_rate_5m > 0.1 then increase surge_cap.
suggest surge_cap = ceil(active_spot_nodes * 0.25)

maria: +1 on factoring eviction. Also we should add a penalty_window after an eviction so autoscaler doesn't immediately scale down and re-add nodes.
I usually set penalty_window = 300s for GCP preemptibles.

tim: allocation affinity: prefer mixed-capacity pools (spot first, then reserved). fallback to on-demand when estimated interruption_prob > 0.3 or p99_queue_ms > 5s.

anya: good call. propose a short pseudo-config we can try in canary:

```
autoscaler:
  scale_out:
    metric: p95_queue_ms
    threshold_ms: 1200
    cool_down: 45
  headroom:
    mode: dynamic
    ratio: 0.12
    min_nodes: 1
  surge:
    max_pct: 0.25
    penalty_window_s: 300
  fallback:
    on_demand_threshold: 0.3 # interruption prob
```

kevin: add metrics we need: p95_queue_ms, eviction_rate_5m, interruption_prob_estimate, active_spot_nodes, available_surge_slots. we'll also export a derived metric "cost_per_token_estimate" for decisioning.

srebot: Deploy queued: autoscaler/v2.3 canary -> eng-infra-canary-region-1

maria: for tests, can we simulate burst + 20% eviction? also run a slow-scheduler scenario (scheduling_delay p95=800ms)

tim: agree. also instrument a "penalty_hits" counter so we can see when penalty_window prevented scale-in.

anya: I'll open the PR with the config + k8s HPA adapter changes, add tests for eviction spike + penalty window. assign kevin for perf tests and maria for canary signoff.

kevin: ack. I'll prepare load script and cost sims.

maria: ack, will run canary tomorrow morning and report.

anya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
